commit_message: Diagnose lossy PMX Secondary Motion hints
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0112 engine-native Secondary Motion. This follow-up makes lossy PMX physics hint conversion explicit and non-fatal: unsupported soft bodies, invalid rigid-body bone bindings, and unknown rigid-body modes now emit actionable diagnostics while preserving usable model import. It also removes the obsolete PMX/runtime scale-coupling compatibility namespace and regression test.

The PR remains Draft while stale PMX documentation and remaining MMD-only dead code/compatibility surfaces are audited and cleaned up, followed by final validation.
